newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHKELE ASKS DEFENCE MINISTER TO QUIT.
newsitem.headline: SHKELE ASKS DEFENCE MINISTER TO QUIT.

text.p: Prime Minister Andris Shkele has asked Defence Minister Andrejs Krastinsh to resign.
Shkele told a news conference that Krastinsh signed orders to buy fuel for the army at a price that was too high.
"I have demanded the resignation of Defence Minister Andrejs Krastinsh as I have lost confidence in him," Shkele said.
Shkele said the fuel deals violated state procurement rules and accused Krastinsh of corruption.
"The fighting of corruption has to become one of the main jobs of the state and all those to do with state funds have to be aware that their activiees will be scrutinised very closely," Shkele said.
Krastinsh is a member of the minor ruling party the LNNK, which forms part of Shkele's eight-party coalition government.
